settings.name: max_parallel_maintenance_workers
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel processes per maintenance operation.

settings.name: max_parallel_workers
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel workers that can be active at one time.

settings.name: max_parallel_workers_per_gather
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of parallel processes per executor node.

settings.extra_desc: If more than this number of tuples on the same page are locked by a connection, those locks are replaced by a page-level lock.
settings.name: max_pred_locks_per_page
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate-locked tuples per page.

settings.extra_desc: If more than this total of pages and tuples in the same relation are locked by a connection, those locks are replaced by a relation-level lock.
settings.name: max_pred_locks_per_relation
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate-locked pages and tuples per relation.

settings.extra_desc: The shared predicate lock table is sized on the assumption that at most max_pred_locks_per_transaction * max_connections distinct objects will need to be locked at any one time.
settings.name: max_pred_locks_per_transaction
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of predicate locks per transaction.

settings.name: max_prepared_transactions
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously prepared transactions.

settings.name: max_replication_slots
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously defined replication slots.

settings.extra_desc: Replication slots will be marked as failed, and segments released for deletion or recycling, if this much space is occupied by WAL on disk.
settings.name: max_slot_wal_keep_size
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum WAL size that can be reserved by replication slots.

settings.name: max_stack_depth
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum stack depth, in kilobytes.

settings.name: max_standby_archive_delay
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum delay before canceling queries when a hot standby server is processing archived WAL data.

settings.name: max_standby_streaming_delay
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum delay before canceling queries when a hot standby server is processing streamed WAL data.

settings.name: max_sync_workers_per_subscription
settings.short_desc: Maximum number of table synchronization workers per subscription.

settings.name: max_wal_senders
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of simultaneously running WAL sender processes.

settings.name: max_wal_size
settings.short_desc: Sets the WAL size that triggers a checkpoint.

settings.name: max_worker_processes
settings.short_desc: Maximum number of concurrent worker processes.

settings.extra_desc: If the planner estimates that it will read a number of index pages too small to reach this limit, a parallel scan will not be considered.
settings.name: min_parallel_index_scan_size
settings.short_desc: Sets the minimum amount of index data for a parallel scan.

settings.extra_desc: If the planner estimates that it will read a number of table pages too small to reach this limit, a parallel scan will not be considered.
settings.name: min_parallel_table_scan_size
settings.short_desc: Sets the minimum amount of table data for a parallel scan.

settings.name: min_wal_size
settings.short_desc: Sets the minimum size to shrink the WAL to.

settings.extra_desc: A value of -1 disables this feature.
settings.name: old_snapshot_threshold
settings.short_desc: Time before a snapshot is too old to read pages changed after the snapshot was taken.

settings.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
settings.name: operator_precedence_warning
settings.short_desc: Emit a warning for constructs that changed meaning since PostgreSQL 9.4.

settings.extra_desc: Should gather nodes also run subplans, or just gather tuples?
settings.name: parallel_leader_participation
settings.short_desc: Controls whether Gather and Gather Merge also run subplans.

settings.name: parallel_setup_cost
settings.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of starting up worker processes for parallel query.

settings.name: parallel_tuple_cost
settings.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of passing each tuple (row) from worker to master backend.

settings.name: password_encryption
settings.short_desc: Chooses the algorithm for encrypting passwords.

settings.extra_desc: Prepared statements can have custom and generic plans, and the planner will attempt to choose which is better.  This can be set to override the default behavior.
settings.name: plan_cache_mode
settings.short_desc: Controls the planner's selection of custom or generic plan.

settings.name: port
settings.short_desc: Sets the TCP port the server listens on.

settings.extra_desc: This allows attaching a debugger to the process.
settings.name: post_auth_delay
settings.short_desc: Waits N seconds on connection startup after authentication.

settings.extra_desc: This allows attaching a debugger to the process.
settings.name: pre_auth_delay
settings.short_desc: Waits N seconds on connection startup before authentication.

settings.name: primary_conninfo
settings.short_desc: Sets the connection string to be used to connect to the sending server.

settings.name: primary_slot_name
settings.short_desc: Sets the name of the replication slot to use on the sending server.

settings.name: promote_trigger_file
settings.short_desc: Specifies a file name whose presence ends recovery in the standby.

settings.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
settings.name: quote_all_identifiers
settings.short_desc: When generating SQL fragments, quote all identifiers.

settings.name: random_page_cost
settings.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a nonsequentially fetched disk page.

settings.name: recovery_end_command
settings.short_desc: Sets the shell command that will be executed once at the end of recovery.

settings.name: recovery_min_apply_delay
settings.short_desc: Sets the minimum delay for applying changes during recovery.

settings.name: recovery_target
settings.short_desc: Set to "immediate" to end recovery as soon as a consistent state is reached.

settings.name: recovery_target_action
settings.short_desc: Sets the action to perform upon reaching the recovery target.

settings.name: recovery_target_inclusive
settings.short_desc: Sets whether to include or exclude transaction with recovery target.

settings.name: recovery_target_lsn
settings.short_desc: Sets the LSN of the write-ahead log location up to which recovery will proceed.

settings.name: recovery_target_name
settings.short_desc: Sets the named restore point up to which recovery will proceed.

settings.name: recovery_target_time
settings.short_desc: Sets the time stamp up to which recovery will proceed.

settings.name: recovery_target_timeline
settings.short_desc: Specifies the timeline to recover into.

settings.name: recovery_target_xid
settings.short_desc: Sets the transaction ID up to which recovery will proceed.

settings.name: restart_after_crash
settings.short_desc: Reinitialize server after backend crash.

settings.name: restore_command
settings.short_desc: Sets the shell command that will be called to retrieve an archived WAL file.

settings.name: restrict_nonsystem_relation_kind
settings.short_desc: Prohibits access to non-system relations of specified kinds.

settings.extra_desc: When enabled, row security will be applied to all users.
settings.name: row_security
settings.short_desc: Enable row security.

settings.name: search_path
settings.short_desc: Sets the schema search order for names that are not schema-qualified.

settings.name: segment_size
settings.short_desc: Shows the number of pages per disk file.

settings.name: seq_page_cost
settings.short_desc: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a sequentially fetched disk page.

settings.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
settings.name: server_encoding
settings.short_desc: Sets the server (database) character set encoding.

settings.name: server_version
settings.short_desc: Shows the server version.

settings.name: server_version_num
settings.short_desc: Shows the server version as an integer.

settings.category: Client Connection Defaults / Shared Library Preloading
settings.name: session_preload_libraries
settings.short_desc: Lists shared libraries to preload into each backend.

settings.name: session_replication_role
settings.short_desc: Sets the session's behavior for triggers and rewrite rules.

settings.name: shared_buffers
settings.short_desc: Sets the number of shared memory buffers used by the server.

settings.name: shared_memory_type
settings.short_desc: Selects the shared memory implementation used for the main shared memory region.

settings.category: Client Connection Defaults / Shared Library Preloading
settings.name: shared_preload_libraries
settings.short_desc: Lists shared libraries to preload into server.

settings.name: ssl
settings.short_desc: Enables SSL connections.

settings.name: ssl_ca_file
settings.short_desc: Location of the SSL certificate authority file.

settings.name: ssl_cert_file
settings.short_desc: Location of the SSL server certificate file.

settings.name: ssl_ciphers
settings.short_desc: Sets the list of allowed SSL ciphers.

settings.name: ssl_crl_file
settings.short_desc: Location of the SSL certificate revocation list file.

settings.name: ssl_dh_params_file
settings.short_desc: Location of the SSL DH parameters file.

settings.name: ssl_ecdh_curve
settings.short_desc: Sets the curve to use for ECDH.

settings.name: ssl_key_file
settings.short_desc: Location of the SSL server private key file.

settings.name: ssl_library
settings.short_desc: Name of the SSL library.

settings.name: ssl_max_protocol_version
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum SSL/TLS protocol version to use.

settings.name: ssl_min_protocol_version
settings.short_desc: Sets the minimum SSL/TLS protocol version to use.

settings.name: ssl_passphrase_command
settings.short_desc: Command to obtain passphrases for SSL.

settings.name: ssl_passphrase_command_supports_reload
settings.short_desc: Also use ssl_passphrase_command during server reload.

settings.name: ssl_prefer_server_ciphers
settings.short_desc: Give priority to server ciphersuite order.

settings.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
settings.name: standard_conforming_strings
settings.short_desc: Causes '...' strings to treat backslashes literally.

settings.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.
settings.name: statement_timeout
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any statement.

settings.category: Statistics / Query and Index Statistics Collector
settings.name: stats_temp_directory
settings.short_desc: Writes temporary statistics files to the specified directory.

settings.name: superuser_reserved_connections
settings.short_desc: Sets the number of connection slots reserved for superusers.

settings.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
settings.name: synchronize_seqscans
settings.short_desc: Enable synchronized sequential scans.

settings.name: synchronous_commit
settings.short_desc: Sets the current transaction's synchronization level.

settings.name: synchronous_standby_names
settings.short_desc: Number of synchronous standbys and list of names of potential synchronous ones.

settings.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
settings.name: syslog_facility
settings.short_desc: Sets the syslog "facility" to be used when syslog enabled.

settings.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
settings.name: syslog_ident
settings.short_desc: Sets the program name used to identify PostgreSQL messages in syslog.

settings.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
settings.name: syslog_sequence_numbers
settings.short_desc: Add sequence number to syslog messages to avoid duplicate suppression.

settings.category: Reporting and Logging / Where to Log
settings.name: syslog_split_messages
settings.short_desc: Split messages sent to syslog by lines and to fit into 1024 bytes.

settings.extra_desc: This controls the number of consecutive keepalive retransmits that can be lost before a connection is considered dead. A value of 0 uses the system default.
settings.name: tcp_keepalives_count
settings.short_desc: Maximum number of TCP keepalive retransmits.

settings.extra_desc: A value of 0 uses the system default.
settings.name: tcp_keepalives_idle
settings.short_desc: Time between issuing TCP keepalives.

settings.extra_desc: A value of 0 uses the system default.
settings.name: tcp_keepalives_interval
settings.short_desc: Time between TCP keepalive retransmits.

settings.extra_desc: A value of 0 uses the system default.
settings.name: tcp_user_timeout
settings.short_desc: TCP user timeout.

settings.name: temp_buffers
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum number of temporary buffers used by each session.

settings.extra_desc: -1 means no limit.
settings.name: temp_file_limit
settings.short_desc: Limits the total size of all temporary files used by each process.

settings.name: temp_tablespaces
settings.short_desc: Sets the tablespace(s) to use for temporary tables and sort files.

settings.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
settings.name: TimeZone
settings.short_desc: Sets the time zone for displaying and interpreting time stamps.

settings.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
settings.name: timezone_abbreviations
settings.short_desc: Selects a file of time zone abbreviations.

settings.name: trace_notify
settings.short_desc: Generates debugging output for LISTEN and NOTIFY.

settings.extra_desc: Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the fewer messages are sent.
settings.name: trace_recovery_messages
settings.short_desc: Enables logging of recovery-related debugging information.

settings.name: trace_sort
settings.short_desc: Emit information about resource usage in sorting.

settings.category: Statistics / Query and Index Statistics Collector
settings.extra_desc: Enables the collection of information on the currently executing command of each session, along with the time at which that command began execution.
settings.name: track_activities
settings.short_desc: Collects information about executing commands.

settings.name: track_activity_query_size
settings.short_desc: Sets the size reserved for pg_stat_activity.query, in bytes.

settings.name: track_commit_timestamp
settings.short_desc: Collects transaction commit time.

settings.category: Statistics / Query and Index Statistics Collector
settings.name: track_counts
settings.short_desc: Collects statistics on database activity.

settings.category: Statistics / Query and Index Statistics Collector
settings.name: track_functions
settings.short_desc: Collects function-level statistics on database activity.

settings.category: Statistics / Query and Index Statistics Collector
settings.name: track_io_timing
settings.short_desc: Collects timing statistics for database I/O activity.

settings.name: transaction_deferrable
settings.short_desc: Whether to defer a read-only serializable transaction until it can be executed with no possible serialization failures.

settings.name: transaction_isolation
settings.short_desc: Sets the current transaction's isolation level.

settings.name: transaction_read_only
settings.short_desc: Sets the current transaction's read-only status.

settings.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Other Platforms and Clients
settings.extra_desc: When turned on, expressions of the form expr = NULL (or NULL = expr) are treated as expr IS NULL, that is, they return true if expr evaluates to the null value, and false otherwise. The correct behavior of expr = NULL is to always return null (unknown).
settings.name: transform_null_equals
settings.short_desc: Treats "expr=NULL" as "expr IS NULL".

settings.name: unix_socket_directories
settings.short_desc: Sets the directories where Unix-domain sockets will be created.

settings.extra_desc: The owning user of the socket is always the user that starts the server.
settings.name: unix_socket_group
settings.short_desc: Sets the owning group of the Unix-domain socket.

settings.extra_desc: Unix-domain sockets use the usual Unix file system permission set. The parameter value is expected to be a numeric mode specification in the form accepted by the chmod and umask system calls. (To use the customary octal format the number must start with a 0 (zero).)
settings.name: unix_socket_permissions
settings.short_desc: Sets the access permissions of the Unix-domain socket.

settings.extra_desc: Enables updating of the process title every time a new SQL command is received by the server.
settings.name: update_process_title
settings.short_desc: Updates the process title to show the active SQL command.

settings.name: vacuum_cleanup_index_scale_factor
settings.short_desc: Number of tuple inserts prior to index cleanup as a fraction of reltuples.

settings.name: vacuum_cost_delay
settings.short_desc: Vacuum cost delay in milliseconds.

settings.name: vacuum_cost_limit
settings.short_desc: Vacuum cost amount available before napping.

settings.name: vacuum_cost_page_dirty
settings.short_desc: Vacuum cost for a page dirtied by vacuum.

settings.name: vacuum_cost_page_hit
settings.short_desc: Vacuum cost for a page found in the buffer cache.

settings.name: vacuum_cost_page_miss
settings.short_desc: Vacuum cost for a page not found in the buffer cache.

settings.name: vacuum_defer_cleanup_age
settings.short_desc: Number of transactions by which VACUUM and HOT cleanup should be deferred, if any.

settings.name: vacuum_freeze_min_age
settings.short_desc: Minimum age at which VACUUM should freeze a table row.

settings.name: vacuum_freeze_table_age
settings.short_desc: Age at which VACUUM should scan whole table to freeze tuples.

settings.name: vacuum_multixact_freeze_min_age
settings.short_desc: Minimum age at which VACUUM should freeze a MultiXactId in a table row.

settings.name: vacuum_multixact_freeze_table_age
settings.short_desc: Multixact age at which VACUUM should scan whole table to freeze tuples.

settings.name: wal_block_size
settings.short_desc: Shows the block size in the write ahead log.

settings.name: wal_buffers
settings.short_desc: Sets the number of disk-page buffers in shared memory for WAL.

settings.name: wal_compression
settings.short_desc: Compresses full-page writes written in WAL file.

settings.extra_desc: Full-page images will be logged for all data blocks and cross-checked against the results of WAL replay.
settings.name: wal_consistency_checking
settings.short_desc: Sets the WAL resource managers for which WAL consistency checks are done.

settings.name: wal_init_zero
settings.short_desc: Writes zeroes to new WAL files before first use.

settings.name: wal_keep_size
settings.short_desc: Sets the size of WAL files held for standby servers.

settings.name: wal_level
settings.short_desc: Set the level of information written to the WAL.

settings.name: wal_log_hints
settings.short_desc: Writes full pages to WAL when first modified after a checkpoint, even for a non-critical modification.

settings.name: wal_receiver_create_temp_slot
settings.short_desc: Sets whether a WAL receiver should create a temporary replication slot if no permanent slot is configured.

settings.name: wal_receiver_status_interval
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum interval between WAL receiver status reports to the sending server.

settings.name: wal_receiver_timeout
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum wait time to receive data from the sending server.

settings.name: wal_recycle
settings.short_desc: Recycles WAL files by renaming them.

settings.name: wal_retrieve_retry_interval
settings.short_desc: Sets the time to wait before retrying to retrieve WAL after a failed attempt.

settings.name: wal_segment_size
settings.short_desc: Shows the size of write ahead log segments.

settings.name: wal_sender_timeout
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum time to wait for WAL replication.

settings.name: wal_skip_threshold
settings.short_desc: Size of new file to fsync instead of writing WAL.

settings.name: wal_sync_method
settings.short_desc: Selects the method used for forcing WAL updates to disk.

settings.name: wal_writer_delay
settings.short_desc: Time between WAL flushes performed in the WAL writer.

settings.name: wal_writer_flush_after
settings.short_desc: Amount of WAL written out by WAL writer that triggers a flush.

settings.extra_desc: This much memory can be used by each internal sort operation and hash table before switching to temporary disk files.
settings.name: work_mem
settings.short_desc: Sets the maximum memory to be used for query workspaces.

settings.name: xmlbinary
settings.short_desc: Sets how binary values are to be encoded in XML.

settings.name: xmloption
settings.short_desc: Sets whether XML data in implicit parsing and serialization operations is to be considered as documents or content fragments.

settings.extra_desc: Detection of a damaged page header normally causes PostgreSQL to report an error, aborting the current transaction. Setting zero_damaged_pages to true causes the system to instead report a warning, zero out the damaged page, and continue processing. This behavior will destroy data, namely all the rows on the damaged page.
settings.name: zero_damaged_pages
settings.short_desc: Continues processing past damaged page headers.
